summary:
I built the app on `desk:apps:temp` and checked it in the running app: 77 gives F: 170.6, 2 gives 35.6, -40.5 gives -40.9, and letters are ignored.

It is a 29-line page with no other pages touched; nothing else on the desk changed.

One choice I made: numbers too large for Unseen Script (13 digits and up) would have closed the app, so for those the app shows `F: ?` instead. The spec didn't cover that case.

files.desk:apps:temp:
app 'Celsius to Fahrenheit'
task start()
give ''
done
task typed(k)
give (k is '-') or (k is '.') or (find('0123456789', k) > 0)
done
task key(s, k)
when k is 'backspace'
give edit_text(s, k)
done
when typed(k)
give edit_text(s, k)
done
give s
done
task draw(s)
title('Celsius to Fahrenheit')
show(1, 1, 'C: ' & s)
when is_number(s)
try
show(2, 1, 'F: ' & text(number(s) * 9 / 5 + 32))
instead err
show(2, 1, 'F: ?')
done
otherwise
show(2, 1, 'F: ?')
done
done
